ideas.pitch: An offline-first, mobile-friendly crop disease and soil health monitoring platform built specifically for local agricultural conditions in Bihar, utilizing image classification models optimized for low-bandwidth devices.
ideas.title: Araria FarmGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the agriculture domain highlighted by the engineering college organizers while solving a hyper-local economic problem.

ideas.pitch: A localized, multi-lingual voice-to-text educational assistant designed for rural students to access curriculum help in regional languages like Maithili and Hindi without needing high-end hardware.
ideas.title: Gram Shiksha Renu
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the education domain focus of the hackathon with a strong social impact angle that appeals to local academic judges.

ideas.pitch: A low-cost IoT sensor data aggregator combined with a predictive machine learning model to forecast local water level anomalies and alert community stakeholders via SMS.
ideas.title: Kosi River Flood Early Warning Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages difficult engineering (predictive forecasting and hardware-software integration) addressing regional disaster management relevant to Araria.

ideas.pitch: An offline-capable patient symptom triage and electronic health record manager tailored for primary health centers in rural Bihar.
ideas.title: Swasthya Setu Rural Health Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns tightly with the healthcare domain priority and solves a practical deployment challenge for resource-constrained environments.

ideas.pitch: An alternative credit scoring prototype for local artisans and small shop owners using digital transaction histories and micro-behavioral data.
ideas.title: BazaarLink MSME Credit Scorer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the entrepreneurship domain by providing a tangible financial inclusion tool that resonates with state-level economic development goals.
